title: gemma-4-sql-libtpu A/B experiment variables
description: Configuration variables for comparing upstream Google libtpu ('og') vs. libtpu-rs ('rs') across the gemma-4-sql 7-backend Cloud TPU suite.

GEMMA_4_SQL_AB_PROVIDERS.description: Comma-separated ordered list of libtpu runtime providers ('og' and 'rs') evaluated across all selected Gemma 4 backends.

GEMMA_4_SQL_AB_RESULTS_DIR.description: Root output directory containing og/, rs/, ab_comparison_summary.{json,csv,md}, and generated_metrics.tex.

GEMMA_4_SQL_AB_FRESH_VM_PER_PROVIDER.description: Flag (0 or 1) deleting and reprovisioning a fresh Cloud TPU VM slice between 'og' and 'rs' provider passes.

GEMMA_4_SQL_AB_VERIFY_DISTINCT_SHA.description: Flag (0 or 1) asserting that Stage A mapped libtpu.so SHA-256 digests differ between 'og' and 'rs' runs.

GEMMA_4_SQL_REPO_DIR.description: Local filesystem path to the SamuelMarks/gemma-4-sql workspace repository.

GEMMA_4_SQL_PAPER_DIR.description: Optional manuscript directory receiving copied generated_metrics.tex and optional compiled PDF verification.

GEMMA_4_SQL_MODEL.description: Hugging Face or KerasHub Gemma 4 model checkpoint identifier.

GEMMA_4_SQL_BACKENDS.description: Comma-separated list of Gemma 4 TPU backend identifiers ('all' or subset of the 7 canonical backends).

GEMMA_4_SQL_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated list of gemma-4-sql sub-suites executed per provider ('E0,E1,E2,E3,E4').

GEMMA_4_SQL_BATCH_SIZES.description: Comma-separated integer batch sizes evaluated in Suite E1 prefill and decode throughput sweeps.

GEMMA_4_SQL_WARMUP.description: Number of untimed warmup iterations executed prior to measured steady-state runs.

GEMMA_4_SQL_TRIALS.description: Number of measured steady-state benchmark runs captured per workload cell.

GEMMA_4_SQL_SHM_ROOT.description: Root tmpfs directory used for isolated twin (<group>-og and <group>-rs) uv virtualenvs and shared model caches.

GEMMA_4_SQL_RENDER_LATEX.description: Flag (0 or 1) synthesizing ab_comparison_summary.{json,csv,md} and generated_metrics.tex idempotently from existing og/ and rs/ outputs.

GEMMA_4_SQL_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) validating configuration and logging planned actions without running TPU workloads.
